Operations Data Analyst, NYSC Job at GE Vernovas




        
    

        
        
     

            
    

GE Vernovas a planned, purpose-built global energy company that includes Power, Wind, and Electrification segments and is supported by its accelerator businesses of Advanced Research, Consulting Services, and Financial Services. Building on over 130 years of experience tackling the world’s challenges, GE Vernova is uniquely positioned to help lead the energy transition by continuing to electrify the world while simultaneously working to decarbonize it. GE Vernova helps customers power economies and deliver electricity that is vital to health, safety, security, and improved quality of life. GE Vernova is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, U.S., with more than 80,000 employees across 140+ countries around the world. GE Vernova’s Gas Power business engineers advanced, efficient natural gas-powered technologies and services, along with decarbonization solutions that aim to help electrify a lower carbon future.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Operations Data Analyst, NYSC 

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: NYSC
Job ID: R5049415

Job Description Summary


	GE Vernova Gas Power is pleased to offer selected graduating students the opportunity to join our business for an  internship.
	You will be exposed to our business, which provides a perfect opportunity for us to learn about you and your interests and for you to learn about GE Vernova and a career with us.
	In this role you will utilize science, engineering, and operations knowledge and experience to solve problems, develop and execute objectives for self and others. You will be assigned a project to drive which will support the business priorities.


Key Responsibilities


	Support the GE Vernova Power Business with business optimization actions as defined by the Operations Leader
	Manage the SSA region operations data webpage: ensuring accurate and on-time updates as well as tracking hit rate and use cases for the website
	Collaborate with the Information Technology Manager (ITM) to consult IT knowledgebases (KB's) and resources for proper troubleshooting.
	Develop and track dashboard on operations incident reports


Required Qualifications


	Cumulative Grade Point Average (GPA) of not less than 3.5 (Second Class Upper)
	Academic excellence in Science, Engineering, IT competency
	Verified posting by NYSC to GE and completion of the mandatory 3 weeks orientation camp.
	Passion for technology and previous experience in the GE sales process will be an added advantage
	Demonstrated leadership ability and initiative
	Strong communication, interpersonal, and influencing skills
	Verified posting/call up letter to Lagos.
	Computer proficiency


Desired Characteristics:


	Strong oral and written communication skills
	Strong interpersonal and leadership skills
	Ability to establish and maintain good customer relations
	Excellent organizational skills


Additional Information:


	Relocation Assistance Provided: No.


Remuneration
GE Vernova Nigeria interns will receive many benefits including:


	Challenging work assignments
	Exposure to a multinational

title: Job Openings at Flutterwave
content:
Flutterwave was founded on the principle that every African must be able to participate and thrive in the global economy. To achieve this objective, we have built a trusted payment infrastructure that allows consumers and businesses (African and International) make and receive payments in a convenient border-less manner.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below: 

1.) Backend Engineer, C# 

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are looking for a Back-End Engineer (C#) who is a driven, passionate and committed individual to join the team as we grow and expand across Africa and beyond.
	As our Back-end Engineer you are able to Identify, prioritize and execute tasks in the software development life cycle of a product, manage and oversee projects for the company 


Responsibilities
What Your Day to Day Activities Will Be Like:


	Effective utilization of C# to develop effective user interface on our product application
	Create innovative solutions to web design issues to help make the application more visually appealing and enhance usability
	Understanding Framework of C# and its accompanying stack
	Experience with building fully responsive web applications
	Working Knowledge with collaboration tools such as Git
	Ensure personal information of customers, employees, and other individuals the company conducts business with is processed and protected in line with applicable data privacy policies, privacy laws, and global best practices.
	Ensure quick Updates on our product application to make them effective


Other responsibilities:


	A good demonstration of object-oriented or functional analysis design skills
	Demonstrate a good understanding of data structures, algorithms and designing for performance.
	Coding creative, operational or frontend software that helps the designated product build
	Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
	Integrate with the back- end systems and APIs
	Creating Functional and intuitive applications and features.
	Contribute to engineering efforts from designing to implementation, solving complex technical challenges around developer and engineering productivity and velocity


Requirements
Required competency and skillset to be a waver:


	Bachelors Degree required
	Minimum 4 years of experience 
	Proficient understanding of C# is essential
	Very resourceful and comfortable working under short timelines and intense pressure to deliver in seemingly impossible situations 
	Flexible & Proactive
	Data-driven and Efficient


Click here to apply online

 

 

2.) Senior  Engineer, Technical Program Management

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos

Job Summary


	Flutterwave is looking for a motivated senior engineer to join our dynamic technical program management team.
	In this role, you will support the coordination and delivery of engineering projects that strengthen our payment infrastructure.
	You will work within engineering teams, alongside product managers and other stakeholders, to assist in successful project execution and delivery.


Responsibilities
Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Program Management:


	Drive the planning, execution, and delivery of engineering project workstreams
	Define project scope, objectives, milestones, and deliverables
	Develop detailed project plans, including timelines, resource allocation, and risk management strategies
	Track project progress, identify potential risks and issues, and implement mitigation strategies


Cross-functional Collaboration:


	Work closely with engineering, product management, operations, and other cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and successful project outcomes.
	Facilitate communication and collaboration among stakeholders to ensure clarity and consistency in project goals and deliverables.


Technical Expertise:


	Contribute to technical discussions and provide support to engineering teams, adhering to best practices and quality standards.
	Assist in reviewing technical designs and documentation to ensure alignment with project tasks and system requirements


Process Improvement:


	Identify opportunities for process improvement and implement best practices to enhance project management efficiency and effectiveness.
	Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimise project delivery and team performance.


Requirements
Required competency and skillset to be a waver:


	Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
	Minimum 5 years of experience in technical program management or a related role, preferably within the payments or financial technology industry
	Strong technical background with hands-on experience in software engineering or a related field
	Proven track record of successfully managing and delivering complex engineering projects on time and within scope
	Excellent project management skills, including proficiency with project management tools and methodologies
	Strong organizational and task management abilities
	Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse teams and stakeholders
	Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate complex technical challenges
	Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies is highly desirable
	PMP, Scrum Master, or other relevant certifications are a plus.


Click here to apply online

 

3.) Market and Strategic Research Specialist

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos

The Role


	We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical Market and Strategic Research Specialist for a 6-month contract to lead critical research and longitudinal data synthesis for brand storytelling initiative(s).
	In this role, you will analyze multi-year market trends, structure platform metrics, evaluate historical datasets, and gather real-world stakeholder stories to showcase our market presence and long-term economic footprint.
	If you excel at digging into historical data, conducting qualitative interviews, evaluating broad market dynamics, and turning raw numbers into compelling, publication-ready reports and visual decks, this role is for you.


Responsibilities 


	Longitudinal Data Aggregation & Analysis: Pull, clean, structure, and analyze multi-year historical datasets from internal systems (CRM, platform logs, survey archives) alongside external benchmarks to track growth metrics and operational evolution.
	Retrospective & Market Research: Conduct desk research and macroeconomic assessments to contextualize internal performance and track long-term trends against broader fintech, payments, and regional economic shifts.
	Mixed-Methods Stakeholder Research: Design and deploy user/partner surveys, conduct structured qualitative interviews (e.g., with merchants, partners, and key stakeholders), and draft deep-dive impact case studies.
	Cross-Functional Coordination: Act as the operational research hub — collaborating with Data, Operations, Strategy, and Marketing teams to gather internal data inputs and validate historical findings.
	Reporting & Visual Storytelling: Translate research into clean presentation decks, executive summaries, data dashboards, and comprehensive analytical reports that clearly communicate long-term outcomes to internal leadership and external stakeholders.


Required Competency and Skillset to be a Waver


	Experience: 2–4 years in market research, economic analysis, business intelligence, fintech/payments research, or management consulting.
	Research & Analytical Skills:
	
		Strong proficiency in quantitative analysis (data cleaning, working with messy or multi-year datasets, tracking growth metrics over extended time horizons).
		Demonstrated qualitative research expertise (conducting interviews, writing case studies, thematic coding).
	
	
	Tooling Mastery: Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, formulas, data modeling), survey tools (Typeform, SurveyMonkey, or Qualtrics), and presentation tools (PowerPoint, Google Slides, or Canva). 
	Visual Storytelling: Exceptional ability to turn dense, complex spreadsheets into simple, engaging visual charts and cohesive narrative reports
	Communication: Exceptional written and visual storytelling abilities — ability to translate dense tabular data into clear, engaging visual charts and cohesive narrative reports.
	Organization: Self-directed project manager with strong tracking skills to coordinate multiple research tracks under tight 6-month timelines.
	Market Context: A solid understanding of African fintech, digital payments, and emerging market dynamics is an added advantage.

title: Job Openings at Technotap Nigeria Limited
content:
Since 2002, Technotap Nigeria Limited has been a trusted local manufacturer and supplier of quality paint products. Their innovative Terra, Prosper, and FastHide paints are designed to withstand local climates, offering exceptional fade, mould resistance, and low-odour properties. With a comprehensive range of finishes from matte to textured, and a variety of options to suit different budgets, Technotap Nigeria Limited provides high-quality solutions for all your painting needs. Specializing in both paint manufacturing and professional painting services, they proudly serve the Port Harcourt area and beyond.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below: 

1.) Project Development Officer
     

            
    



Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time 

Job Overview


	We are looking for an ambitious, target-oriented Field Project Development Officerto spearhead our commercial project sales.
	You will prospect and secure business from corporate clients, real estate developers, building contractors, institutions (schools, churches, hospitals), and site engineers for large-scale painting projects across Rivers State.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify, target, and visit active building sites, real estate developments, and institutional facilities to offer commercial painting solutions.
	Conduct site assessments, present product technical specifications, prepare project estimates, and submit competitive tender proposals.
	Build and nurture strong relationships with architects, project managers, quantity surveyors, and painting contractors.
	Drive project sales from initial quote to contract signing and final payment collection.
	Coordinate with factory production and technical teams to ensure timely supply and quality standards for project sites.
	Maintain a pipeline of prospective project leads and report weekly site logs to Management.


Requirements & Qualifications


	Minimum of HND / B.Sc. in Marketing, Business Management, Quantity Surveying, Building Technology, or a related field.
	2+ years of proven B2B sales experience, preferably in paint manufacturing, building materials, construction, or real estate development.
	Demonstrated ability to interpret basic building plans, prepare project estimates/bills of quantities, and present formal proposals.
	Excellent negotiation, relationship-building, and communication skills.


Salary
N100,000 - 120,000 monthly. 

Click here to apply online

 

2.) Field Sales Representative 

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Overview


	We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven FieldSales Representative to drive sales and product distribution across retail channels in Port Harcourt and surrounding areas.
	In this role, you will manage mobile inventory, visit paint dealers, stockists, and distributors, replenish stocks, and secure cash sales on delivery.


Key Responsibilities


	Conduct daily field visits to assigned trade routes, servicing existing paint stockists and onboarding new retail dealers.
	Manage, showcase, and distribute paint product lines directly from the company sales van.
	Solicit purchase orders, negotiate volume orders, and ensure product visibility at dealer shops.
	Conduct strict Cash-on-Delivery (COD) transactions, reconciling daily inventory with cleared sales payments.
	Monitor competitor pricing, product availability, and dealer feedback across major Port Harcourt building materials markets.


Requirements & Qualifications


	Minimum of SSCE/ OND / HND / B.Sc. in anyrelated field.
	1–3 years of hands-on van sales or trade distribution experience (experience in FMCG, building materials, or paint manufacturing is a strong advantage).
	Strong negotiation, interpersonal, and cash-handling skills.


Compensation & Benefits


	Base Salary + Performance Bonus: Base salary plus an attractive percentage bonus on net margins above a monthly sales threshold (?3.5M).
	Logistics and field allowance.

3.) Accountant 

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers

Employment Type: Full-time

What You Will Do


	Manage Core Accounting: Handle day-to-day bookkeeping, general ledger maintenance, accounts payable/receivable, bank reconciliations, and payroll.
	Ensure Tax Compliance: Handle monthly statutory filings and remittances, including VAT, PAYE, and WHT with relevant tax authorities.
	Control Manufacturing Inventory: Oversee tracking, valuation, and periodic physical counts for raw materials, WIP, and finished paint batches.
	Drive Product Costing: Accurately calculate and review the Cost of Goods Manufactured (COGM) and COGS, factoring in raw materials, labor, and overheads.
	Lead Software Migration: Utilize your tech-savviness to help evaluate, set up, and transition our company operations to a new accounting software platform.


What We Are Looking For


	B.Sc. or HND in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (ICAN/ACCA qualification or progress is a plus).
	1 to 3 years of professional accounting experience, with verifiable background in a manufacturing or production environment.
	Strong mastery of cost accounting, inventory management, and Nigerian tax compliance.
	Advanced Excel skills and practical experience working with computerized accounting software/ERP systems.
	High integrity, problem-solving mindset, and project coordination skills for software implementation.


What We Offer


	Competitive salary (Salary: N120,000 - N150,000 monthly) aligned with experience.
